Composer ported from web (components/Composer.tsx) — bordered card holding a + actions menu, the input, and a single send-or-stop control that never shows both, with the web's teaching reminder underneath ("keating won't give you the answer — that's the point"). Light mode — theme preference (System/Light/Dark) in a new UiSettingsProvider layered above the theme provider so the stored choice is known before first paint. This surfaced a real bug: the accent green is only contrast-validated as a background, but was used as text colour throughout — 3.04:1 on the light surface. Added a primaryText role (accentText, 4.96:1) and moved every text/icon usage onto it; dark mode is pixel-identical since the two roles coincide there. Splash now has a light default with a dark variant.

Settings — Appearance (theme, font), Chat (interactive cards, raw provider errors, thinking budget), About You. Each is wired to real behaviour rather than stored and ignored:
- Font installs JetBrains Mono + Roboto and flows typography through the theme (theme.type), so the setting restyles the whole app.
- Thinking budget maps per provider (OpenAI reasoning.effort, Anthropic thinking.budget_tokens with max_tokens raised above it and temperature yielded, Gemini thinkingConfig) and is only sent for models the catalog says support it. - Raw errors keeps the provider's text and derives a friendly summary when off, so the toggle works retroactively on an error already on screen.
- About You appends to the system prompt as JSON-fenced background, mirroring the web's framing so it can't override the teaching protocol.

Live — off the tab bar, entered from the composer. Note the Live screen itself is unchanged: it still explains native Live isn't in this build and links to web. I only moved the entry point, as asked.

Courses — native client: /session, list, join-by-code, and course detail with modules, expandable lessons, materials, and members. Teacher access is an explicit opt-in switch on the join sheet, never implied by joining. content.text:
Read-only audit complete. The composer/settings tranche is not acceptance-ready yet.

1. **P1: Freshly refreshed reasoning models lose reasoning support until restart.**  
   [ModelSelectorSheet.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/components/ModelSelectorSheet.tsx:79) refreshes only its local catalog, then passes the selected model outward at line 153. [KeatingProvider.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:537) persists only provider settings and never merges that model into its own catalog. `supportsReasoning` is then computed from the stale provider catalog at line 597. A newly discovered reasoning model therefore hides Thinking and sends no reasoning budget until the next app launch loads the cache. Merge the selected model into the authoritative catalog immediately and add a no-restart regression test.

2. **P1: “Interactive cards off” can dead-end a tutoring turn.**  
   [system-prompt.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/system-prompt.ts:10) always instructs the model to emit a card, say “Quiz ready,” and stop. [MessageContent.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/components/MessageContent.tsx:45) replaces that card with an inert label when `showToolUi` is false. The learner gets neither questions nor an answer mechanism. This also differs from web, where `showToolUi` controls tool details while retaining compact functional output at [KeatingUiSettingsTab.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/components/KeatingUiSettingsTab.tsx:293). Either condition the card protocol on the setting or render a complete accessible text fallback.

3. **P1: Thinking levels are not model-correct, and OpenRouter uses the wrong request shape.**  
   Mobile reduces capability metadata to one boolean at [model-catalog.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/model-catalog.ts:29), offers the same six levels to every reasoning model, and applies provider-wide mappings in [reasoning.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/reasoning.ts:10). It collapses `xhigh` to `high`, even though current OpenAI models expose `xhigh`; model-specific support also differs for `off`, `minimal`, and `low` as shown in [openai.models.d.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/providers/openai.models.d.ts:392). OpenRouter receives top-level `reasoning_effort` at [provider-client.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/provider-client.ts:158), while the installed provider contract specifies `reasoning: { effort }` at [types.d.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/types.d.ts:407). Carry a model-specific thinking-level map, or reuse the same pi-ai adapter as web.

4. **P1: “Raw provider errors” still discards some raw provider responses.**  
   [provider-client.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/provider-client.ts:305) parses failed response bodies as JSON and replaces non-JSON bodies with a generic HTTP status. The later retroactive toggle works, but the raw body has already been lost. Plain-text custom endpoint errors, proxy HTML, and OpenAI `response.failed` nested errors can therefore become generic messages. Preserve a bounded raw-text fallback and parse provider-specific stream failure events.

5. **P1 parity blocker: Live is presented as an available composer action but remains a web handoff.**  
   [Composer.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/components/Composer.tsx:22) describes the callback as opening a live voice session and labels it “Talk this through by voice.” [index.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:227) only navigates to `/live`, whose screen states native Live is unavailable at [live.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/live.tsx:27). This is a known implementation gap, but it remains a false affordance and explicit final-parity blocker.

6. **P2: About You and persona saves fail optimistically and silently.**  
   [KeatingProvider.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:564) updates in-memory persona/context before storage resolves. [settings.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:184) invokes those promises with `.then(...)` but no error handling. A storage failure leaves the current session using unsaved data, produces an unhandled rejection, and loses it after restart. Surface an inline retryable save error and either roll back or distinguish “active” from “saved.”

7. **P2: Teaching-style temperature is ineffective for OpenAI.**  
   Settings promises that it controls variation at [settings.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:308), but the OpenAI Responses body at [provider-client.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/provider-client.ts:91) never reads `settings.temperature`. Either apply it only to models that accept it or explicitly disable/explain the control for the selected transport.

8. **P2: The composer is visually close, but not feature-equivalent to web.**  
   Mobile correctly has one send-or-stop control, 44dp targets, the compact hint, and a contained action sheet. The actual web composer also has attachment handling at [AssistantChatPanel.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/components/AssistantChatPanel.tsx:3911) and an inline live-voice control at line 4783. Mobile substitutes the unavailable Live route and has no attachments. Web also exposes reasoning visibility/auto-expand controls at [KeatingUiSettingsTab.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/components/KeatingUiSettingsTab.tsx:300), while mobile drops reasoning output entirely.
